Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the necessary birthdate information from the search results page. Instead of providing a summary of the search results or clicking on the most relevant link (GoldDerby) to gather the data, it only reported the metadata and OCR text of the search results page without taking any action to retrieve the specific information needed. This is a failure to execute the task of gathering data, as it did not proceed to the actual source of the information despite the search results clearly indicating where the data could be found.
